To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) the receding-honizon control law is resilient against the replay attacks; (b) the system performance degradation is bounded;

(i) the performance of resilient control systems can be degraded due to replay attacks; and (ii) the performance degradation can be mitigated by a variation of the standard receding-horizons control law and by a class of cooperative resource allocation strategies.
We propose an algorithm that can achieve the same performance as that of the optimal algorithm, but with much less computational complexity.
